metadata.title: When you barely move and Valorant hands you a kill like it’s a participation trophy
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill for chilling?
Enemy must’ve been on a coffee break.
Click if your aim’s garbage but the kills still roll in.
Valorant logic: totally broken, totally hilarious.

Hit like if your best kills are pure accident magic!

#valorant #gamingfails #funnygaming #luckshot #shorts
